optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Cloud Resource Engineer, Customer Service Centre Platform

professionalSummary.text: Managed cloud accounts, quotas, and tagging for telephony and chat services, maintaining current resource inventory in CMDB after each change window.
professionalSummary.witness: Managed the platform's three AWS accounts, quota requests and the tagging policy for the telephony and chat services, keeping the resource inventory current in the CMDB after each change window.

professionalSummary.text: Handled on-call incidents including a June chat-service outage as first responder, applying quota increase and providing 15-minute updates to operations team until resolution.
professionalSummary.witness: Served on the platform on-call rota for nine months and handled the June chat-service outage as first responder: paged at 07:40, identified the exhausted NAT gateway allocation, applied the quota increase and posted status updates to contact-centre operations every fifteen minutes until service was restored at 08:55.

professionalSummary.text: Conducted monthly capacity and cost reviews with platform lead, proposing right-sizing changes with documented savings and rollback paths.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the monthly capacity and cost review with the platform lead, proposing right-sizing of the chat-service instances with the expected monthly saving and the rollback path documented in the change record.

professionalSummary.text: Documented runbooks including quota exhaustion procedures with ticketing system audit history as verification.
professionalSummary.witness: Work sample: the June outage post-incident review (timeline, root cause, actions, approvals) and the chat-service runbook section on quota exhaustion, with the ticketing system's audit history as a verification trail.

experienceHighlights.text: Served nine months on platform on-call rota, handling June chat-service outage as first responder with 15-minute updates to operations team until resolution at 08:55.
experienceHighlights.witness: Served on the platform on-call rota for nine months and handled the June chat-service outage as first responder: paged at 07:40, identified the exhausted NAT gateway allocation, applied the quota increase and posted status updates to contact-centre operations every fifteen minutes until service was restored at 08:55.

experienceHighlights.text: Wrote post-incident review for June outage including timeline, missed capacity alarm, and follow-up actions, approved by platform lead and accepted by operations team.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the post-incident review for the June outage, including the timeline, the missed capacity alarm and the follow-up actions, which the platform lead approved and the operations team accepted.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained runbooks for platform changes with documented hand-over conditions and known limitations.
experienceHighlights.witness: Work sample: the June outage post-incident review (timeline, root cause, actions, approvals) and the chat-service runbook section on quota exhaustion, with the ticketing system's audit history as a verification trail.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: June outage post-incident review and chat-service runbook section on quota exhaustion with ticketing system audit history as verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the June outage post-incident review (timeline, root cause, actions, approvals) and the chat-service runbook section on quota exhaustion, with the ticketing system's audit history as a verification trail.

skills.text: Cloud resource management, incident response, capacity planning, runbook documentation.
skills.witness: Responsibilities included account administration, on-call incident response, capacity reviews and runbook maintenance for the contact-centre platform over two years.
